# KBUILD Web Bundles (Latest)

**⚠️ Unstable Build**: These bundles are auto-generated from the latest `main` branch.

For stable releases, visit [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/kbuild-org/kbuild/releases/latest).

## Usage

Copy raw markdown URLs for use in AI platforms:

- Claude Code: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kbuild-org/kbuild-bundles/main/claude-code/sub-agents/{agent}.md`
- ChatGPT: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kbuild-org/kbuild-bundles/main/chatgpt/sub-agents/{agent}.md`
- Gemini: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kbuild-org/kbuild-bundles/main/gemini/sub-agents/{agent}.md`

## Browse

Visit [https://kbuild-org.github.io/kbuild-bundles/](https://kbuild-org.github.io/kbuild-bundles/) to browse bundles.

## Installation (Recommended)

For full IDE integration:
```bash
npx @kendralabs/kbuild install
```
